6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Once again, I looked at myself in the mirror.

7.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
7.text: Take hold of the sword's hilt.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: It's heaviness felt strange to me.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: I wondered if it would feel any lighter after today.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: The weight and sturdiness of it gave me confidence.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: I assured myself that I was doing this for the sake of the kingdom.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: The whispered hymn gave me solace.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: With faith as my anchor, I knew that everything would be all right.

20.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
20.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Sword"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_TeradorsFury"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_CeremonialSword"] == true)) == false

28.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
28.text: Move away from the mirror and proceed to the waiting area before the speech.
28.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Armor"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Crown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_HolyBook"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Military"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Prayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Robes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Suit"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Sword"] == true

30.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
30.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Armor"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Crown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_HolyBook"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Military"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Prayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Robes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Suit"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Sword"] == true

31.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
31.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Armor"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Crown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_HolyBook"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Military"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Prayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Robes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Suit"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Sword"] == true) == false

32.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
32.text: Proceed to the waiting area before the speech.
32.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Armor"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Crown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_HolyBook"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Military"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Prayer"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Robes"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Suit"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Prep_Hub_Sword"] == true) == false

38.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
38.text: Pick up the Book of Nur.

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: Having chosen my attire, I decided to accessorize, aiming to project the appropriate image of authority and reverence.

41.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
41.text: Wear the armor of Henricus, the first Toras.

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: Pleased, I glanced at my crown, nestled on a velvet cushion. It gleamed with gold and precious gems.

56.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
56.text: Put the crown on your head.

62.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
62.text: Read a few passages from the Book of Nur.

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: Before long, a comforting warmth enveloped me, affirming the righteousness of my journey within.

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: I was unaccustomed to the loose fit, yet I found it strangely liberating.

71.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
71.text: Pin medals on the military uniform.

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: Though it took time to pin each one, the sight of them adorning my uniform brought a smile to my face.

80.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
80.text: Fasten a pair of cuff links to your sleeves.

82.speaker: Narrator
82.text: They were crafted from pure gold with diamond insets. Hugo had gifted them to me on a previous birthday.

83.speaker: Narrator
83.text: As I examined myself from various angles in the mirror, I appreciated the refined appearance the accessories lent me.

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: In that moment, I felt as if I had stepped out of the annals of history --

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: The legacy of valorous kings, their blood coursing through my veins, preparing me for this pivotal moment.

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: I didn't have to wait long before Sal entered.

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "Of course. I've waited my entire life for this."

95.speaker: Sal Ignacius
95.text: "You have nothing to worry about. This has always been your destiny."

96.speaker: Sal Ignacius
96.text: "God is watching over both of us today."

97.speaker: Sal Ignacius
97.text: "It's hard to believe this day has finally arrived. But it was destined by the heavens."

99.speaker: Sal Ignacius
99.text: "Indeed. The day has finally arrived, as decreed by the heavens."

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: He motioned toward the grand balcony doors, where the murmurs of the crowd reached my ears.

102.speaker: Narrator
102.text: As Sal and I stepped outside, the wind swept by us, carrying a thunderous chorus of cheers. There must have been hundreds of thousands in attendance.

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: Sal's resonant voice from the microphone pierced through the clamor of the crowd.

105.speaker: Narrator
105.text: It didn't take long for the crowd to settle down, until finally, a near-total silence fell over the area.

106.speaker: Sal Ignacius
106.text: "Today is perhaps the greatest day in our kingdom's history!"

107.speaker: Sal Ignacius
107.text: "Brothers and sisters... I present to you the promised king, the prophesied king, our king... Romus the First!"
107.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: Cheers and whistles were heard. Once they subsided, Sal continued.

109.speaker: Sal Ignacius
109.text: "People of Rizia! We now revel in the light of the one true God!"

110.speaker: Sal Ignacius
110.text: "None of this would be possible without he who walks and spreads the word of the Divine!"

111.speaker: Sal Ignacius
111.text: "His will is second only to that of God!"

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: The crowd began chanting my name.

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: It was then that the five members of the Council of Nur -- archpriests who replaced my old council -- emerged, each cloaked in a ceremonial robe.

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "Thank you for your guidance. God bless you all."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "Together, we will accomplish what the previous council could not."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius, I'm truly thankful for gathering everyone here today. I hold each of you in the highest regard."

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: They began chanting a continuous prayer, seemingly lost in their devotion.

121.speaker: Sal Ignacius
121.text: "We have built His Kingdom here on earth, a beacon for the world! Halaita!"

126.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
126.text: Unsheath Terador's Fury and direct it toward the sun.

133.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
133.text: Raise the Book of Nur above your head.
133.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_TeradorsFury"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_CeremonialSword"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_HolyBook"] == true)

134.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
134.text: Unsheath the ceremonial sword and direct it toward the sun.

137.speaker: Narrator
137.text: The crowd exploded into fervent chants of "Terador's Fury."

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: The crowd burst into fervent chants of "King Romus!"

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: The crowd burst into fervent chants of "Halaita!"

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: The crowd burst into fervent cheers and applause.

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: The crowd went ecstatic. They held their arms up to the sky.

142.speaker: Narrator
142.text: A sense of immense power came over me -- as if I could command obedience with the slightest twitch of a finger.

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "Under the one true God, I welcome you."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "God's will brought us all here today."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "I am in awe by how much we've achieved in such little time."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Lift your voices and join me in praising the name of God!"

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "Together, we have worked hard to make this moment happen."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "We never surrendered. We shall never surrender."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "This is all because of you. The people of Rizia!"
153.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "And it's all thanks to the unrelenting dedication of Grand Wiseman Ignacius that we were able to make this happen!"
154.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "Under the guidance of the Council of Nur, we will persevere!"
155.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "With the help of Wruhec's Guardians, I will show you the path of the righteous!"
156.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "We are beset by enemies from all sides!"
158.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Enemies"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false)

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Never forget! The future of our country is bright!"
159.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Future"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false)

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "The laws and institutions built by man attempted to suppress us, but they failed!"
160.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Past"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false)

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "We have our work cut out for us! But we are stronger than ever before!"
161.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Present"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false)

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Rizia's opponents are determined to break us!"

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "But, do not forget that the most important enemy is ourselves!"

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Worldly temptations seek to draw us into sin!"

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "But do not falter, my brothers and sisters!"

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "So I say, we must fight back with all we've got!"

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "Take care of each other and stand united against evil!"

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "Yet, we must press on! Until we are victorious!"

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "The Lord is on our side! With His might, we will destroy our adversaries!"

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "God's word is our weapon against the tyranny of mankind!"

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "As the saying goes, where there's a will, there's a way!"

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "We are a nation that knows struggle!"

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "We are a nation that knows peril!"

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "But that's about to change! From this day onward, things will be different!"

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "We are a nation that knows betrayal!"

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "But that's what gives us our strength!"

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "I stand before you as your king, ready to lead us out of this darkness."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "But despite it all, I don't blame my predecessors!"

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "I demand change and so shall you!"

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "For it is you who have shown me that true change comes from within!"

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "We can not fail to forget the past! Or we will be doomed to make the same mistakes again!"

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I hear your calls and I'm in agreement!"

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Let go of the past and concentrate on what awaits us ahead! For dwelling on it only hinders our progress!"

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "What matters is that you are here with me! Right here! Right now!"

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Labor tirelessly without complaint and eternal peace will be your reward!"

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Amidst all this, do not lose sight of what truly matters... our heavenly Father above!"

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "I've seen it first hand! I know the people of Rizia!"

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "Think of your children! Without our sacrifices, their future is bleak!"

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "But do not run yourself rampant in the pursuit of enlightenment! For, according to God's will, true clarity comes at the appointed hour."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "I know that we will succeed! All we need is perseverance!"

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "Rizia demands -- no. *I* demand your eternal fealty!"

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "Times may be hard! But so am I! And so are you!"

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "If you do not stand with me, I cannot predict what fate may befall our beloved country!"

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "Our children will finish what we start today!"

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "We must safeguard what lies ahead with all we have!"

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "But do not be deceived! One misstep and we risk everything!"

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "If you stumble, fear not! I will pull you out of this darkness!"

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "With unwavering devotion, victory will be ours!"

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "I'll be there to witness the future unfold, even at the risk of my life."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "Have faith! Because at the end of the day, all we have is each other!"

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "Sound the bells! For Rizia is coming! Our destiny beckons!"

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "You're the beginning of a new dawn!"

228.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
228.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Enemies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Future"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Past"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Present"] == true

229.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
229.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Enemies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Future"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Past"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Present"] == true) == false

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Your presence here today is a testament to your commitment."
230.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Enemies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Future"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Past"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Speech_Present"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false)

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Henceforth, I proclaim the Wruhecist Kingdom of Rizia!"

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "Henceforth, I proclaim the Divine Sovereignty of Rizia!"

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "Henceforth, I proclaim the Holy Theocracy of Rizia!"

238.speaker: Narrator
238.text: People began to pray, cry, and embrace each other. Some even fainted in their fervor.

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: I let the crowd's celebrations carry on for a while longer, before I waved and retreated inside. The closing doors gradually muted the sounds of jubilation.

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: The moment I entered, Sal, Sevrio and the Council of Nur dropped to their knees in reverence, as did the acolytes.

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: Bowing at my feet, everyone repeated Sal's words in unison.

249.speaker: Sal Ignacius
249.text: "All hail Romus 'the Faithful,' our anointed King, chosen by the will of God."

251.speaker: Narrator
251.text: I leaned down and whispered a prayer for each of them.

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: I had never been so sure of anything in all my life. My mission in this world was clear.

253.speaker: Narrator
253.text: I was led to this moment for a reason.

255.speaker: Narrator
255.text: I closed my eyes and whispered the word.

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "At this very moment, our troops are bravely defending our kingdom from the Palesian heretics!"

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "Yet we shall smite them down, just as we smote Pales!"

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "We will not stop until peace and serenity prevail not only within Rizia but throughout the world!"

292.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
292.text: Wait for the doors to be opened.

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: As I stood before my bedroom mirror, I saw not just a king, but a vessel through which the Divine flowed.

294.speaker: Narrator
294.text: The significance of this moment transcended any mortal event -- my coronation, my wedding, even my birth.

295.speaker: Narrator
295.text: Today, I was tasked with fulfilling God's promises by ushering in a new era for his people, one where His covenant was manifested on earth.

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: This made it all the more important to present myself publicly with the qualities and virtues of the leader I aspired to be.

297.speaker: Narrator
297.text: It fit perfectly, as if it had been made just for me.

301.speaker: Player_Romus
301.text: "Me? Wait, I thought you were giving the speech?"

302.speaker: Narrator
302.text: A moment of sheer panic flashed across Sal's face before he caught onto my jest, emitting a nervous laugh.

303.speaker: Sal Ignacius
303.text: "You certainly know how to keep me on my toes, Your Majesty."

304.speaker: Sal Ignacius
304.text: "Nevertheless, I'm elated that this day has finally come!"

305.speaker: Narrator
305.text: Standing next to Sal, they bowed and raised their hoods.

306.speaker: Narrator
306.text: The crowd raised their voices in unison, filling the air with a harmonious sound.

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "Therefore, I urge you... let us unite and rise up as one!"

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "Do not falter, my brothers and sisters!"

309.speaker: Player_Romus
309.text: "However, I demand change and so shall you!"

310.speaker: Narrator
310.text: The chamber was adorned with grand murals depicting scenes of historic significance.

311.speaker: Narrator
311.text: I knew that soon, the events of this day would be painted alongside them.

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: Sevrio stepped towards us from the doorway.

318.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
318.text: "The crowd outside is massive, but we haven't witnessed any trouble so far. Your followers are as one."

322.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
322.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_TeradorsFury"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_CeremonialSword"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_HolyBook"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Theocracy_Hand_DastScepter"] == true)

324.speaker: Narrator
324.text: The crowd burst into fervent chants of "Nurity across the realm!"

332.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
332.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true

333.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
333.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false

334.speaker: Sal Ignacius
334.text: "But before he speaks, there will be a small demonstration."

335.speaker: Narrator
335.text: He glanced behind me towards the balcony doors.
335.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Titus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectEstela"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true

336.speaker: Sal Ignacius
336.text: "We have enshrined Wruhecism as Rizia's sole religion. Yet I know many lost souls still walk among us, rejecting the teachings of our saint."

337.speaker: Sal Ignacius
337.text: "By King Romus' divine mercy, they shall not be punished. They shall be redeemed."

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: The crowd's applause mixed with exclamations of shock as Titus walked out onto the balcony, the stars on his Wruhec's Guardians uniform gleaming in the sun. A veiled figure trailed behind him.

342.speaker: Titus Gordion
342.text: "After your decree outlawing non-Wruhecist faiths, I remembered the Golden Guard's findings about Madam Estela. I thought it wise to resume our investigation."

343.speaker: Titus Gordion
343.text: "We found Dastnurist prayer books in her possession. And in fact, there is no sign she ever renounced her beliefs."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "So you have chosen to see the light after all, Mother. I'm proud of you."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "Captain Gordion, what is the meaning of this?"

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "This is a mistake. The Queen Mother has already converted to Wruhecism."

350.speaker: Narrator
350.text: Titus lowered his voice to a whisper.

351.speaker: Narrator
351.text: She shook her head and spoke in a soft whisper.

352.speaker: Estela Toras
352.text: "I couldn't go through with it in the end, Romus. I'm sorry."

353.speaker: Narrator
353.text: She shook her head and spoke in a soft whisper.

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "Sal, don't do this. It will destroy her."

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: She shook her head and spoke in a soft whisper.

357.speaker: Estela Toras
357.text: "It's all right, Romus. It's for the good of the kingdom."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "Mother. How could you be so stupid?"

359.speaker: Player_Romus
359.text: "She's 75 years old. Her beliefs aren't hurting anyone."

360.speaker: Estela Toras
360.text: "I could ask you the same thing. Your father may have practiced Wruhecism, but he never would have turned Rizia into the Grand Wiseman's personal pulpit."

361.speaker: Titus Gordion
361.text: "The law is the law, Your Majesty. She must relinquish Dastnurity if she wants to remain in Rizia. And she has agreed to do so."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "It is not too late, Mother. It is never too late."

363.speaker: Titus Gordion
363.text: "Her Highness has already agreed to relinquish Dastnurity, Your Majesty."

364.speaker: Estela Toras
364.text: "I believe you're making a mistake, son. Rizia needs a king, not a cult leader."

365.speaker: Estela Toras
365.text: "But the Royal Family must stand together. No matter what."

366.speaker: Narrator
366.text: She looked at Titus and Sal.

368.speaker: Narrator
368.text: Sal took her hand and together, they stepped up to the microphone. An acolyte stood by with a bowl of glowing coals and a tray containing 11 slips of parchment -- one for each tenet of Dastnurity.

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "You did this without my permission? Are you trying to bring shame on my family?"

370.speaker: Estela Toras
370.text: "He was only executing your orders, Romus."

371.speaker: Sal Ignacius
371.text: "Yes, dear people of Rizia, our very own Queen Mother has come forward as a secret practitioner of the forbidden old ways!"

372.speaker: Sal Ignacius
372.text: "But St. Wruhec preached forgiveness, and our great and merciful King shall grant it!"

373.speaker: Narrator
373.text: The crowd roared louder than ever. The acolyte held the tray out to my mother, and she took one of the slips off of it.

374.speaker: Sal Ignacius
374.text: "With this Rite of Severance, the Queen Mother is reborn into the fold. Showing that there is no one too old, too wicked, too far gone to be saved."

375.speaker: Narrator
375.text: With a trembling hand, she placed the parchment into the bowl. In an instant, it transformed into ash.

376.speaker: Sal Ignacius
376.text: "Yes! Her Highness is destroying the forces that once held sway over her, replacing them with the eternal light of the six stars!"

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: One by one, she cast the other slips into the fire, wincing each time as if it were her own skin that was burning.

378.speaker: Sal Ignacius
378.text: "The holy fire has cleansed her, as it will every one of you! Walk this path with us! Let your kingdom be your salvation!"

379.speaker: Narrator
379.text: The palace grounds resounded with screams of approval and shouts of "Halaita!".

380.speaker: Narrator
380.text: My mother stepped back towards the doors. There were no tears in her eyes -- in fact, there was no emotion at all.

381.speaker: Narrator
381.text: I realized that Sal and the entire crowd were waiting for my words.

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "God bless Queen Mother Estela! And God bless Rizia!"

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "As the Grand Wiseman has spoken, so it shall be! Divine salvation awaits those who follow the words of Wruhec!"

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "The path of redemption is not an easy one. Let us praise the Queen Mother for her bravery!"

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "Thanks for the warm-up, Sal. I'll take it from here."

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: When the last was gone, Sal raised his arms in jubilation.

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: “Wruhecism now stands as the sole state faith.”

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: “We have outlawed the practice of non-Nurist faiths within our borders.”

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: “The South Merkopan University of Theology has elevated religious studies to their rightful place of importance."
397.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

398.speaker: Player_Romus
398.text: “I shall not stop until every town in Rizia, no matter how small, has a Sanctuary to call its own.”
398.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

399.speaker: Player_Romus
399.text: “The Archsanctuary of Plavo -- restored to its former glory.”
399.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "Faithful matters will no longer be overlooked, as religious courts now hold authority."
400.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true)

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: “No more confusion. No more compromise. The state has one faith, as it should.”

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: “It came at a cost, but we’ve made Wruhecism the single guiding light of the state.”

418.speaker: Player_Romus
418.text: “Hard choices were made. But for unity, non-Nurist practices had to be banned.”

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: “We’ve cast out the false voices, and now, only the Nurist path remains.”

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: “Law and faith can now walk in parallel, with each guiding the other.”
420.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true)

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "We have established a new legal system, one where the Lord has the final say in judgement."
421.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true)

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "The grandeur of the Archsanctuary of Plavo has been resurrected."
422.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "The restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary has returned it to its rightful place of reverence."
423.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

424.speaker: Player_Romus
424.text: “Across the realm, sanctuaries rise -- each stone a hymn, each hall a prayer.”
424.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

425.speaker: Player_Romus
425.text: "You asked for a sign. Now our provinces sing with devotion.”
425.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

426.speaker: Player_Romus
426.text: "We are cleansing academia of heathen intellectualism, knowing that 'science' and 'history' cannot compete with the word of God."
426.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)

427.speaker: Player_Romus
427.text: "Our new university will bring scholars from across the continent for reverent study of the Lord's words."
427.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_WruhecismAsSoleFaith"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_BanOnNonNurityFaiths"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_SouthMerkopanUniversityOfTheology_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.WruhecistSanctuariesConstructed"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_EstablishReligiousCourts"] == true) == false)
